page.layout: One page of text in a single column; notes set below the text in smaller type; no margin notes; a catchword-style line "AD VL-" at the lower right; running head at the top.

main_text.p: qui dedit, fuerit constitutum, duxerit, furti reus erit.
Iumentum alterius] vid. Goth. ad l. 40. ff. de furtis.

§. 7. Et multa praeterea, quorumcunque similia sunt, secundum quae & ille furti tenetur, qui ut ferret opem, aut consilium, aut studium commodarit: veluti, si quis pecuniam, quam in manu aliquis tenebat, excusserit, ut alii eam rapere possent.
Ferret opem] vid. Goth. ad l. 36. l. 50. §. 1. ff. de furtis: adde §. 12. vers. si vero. Instit. de oblig. quae ex delict.
Excusserit] vid. Goth. ad l. 52. §. 3. ff. de furtis.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The catchword "AD VL-" is printed at the right foot and is set as a catchword rather than a head. The scan shows heavy speckle and show-through throughout; the faint marks are not transcribed. The printed "Iumentum" and "Excusserit" notes are kept as printed; the foot notes are placed after the text block to which they refer.
